full_text_zh:
[P1] 宝宝健康成长绘本第二辑
捣蛋的“阿嚏”精灵
张冬梅 / 文 梅羽 / 图
江西高校出版社

[P2] “阿嚏，阿嚏，我是‘阿嚏’精灵，最喜欢让人打喷嚏！
阿嚏，阿嚏！ ”
阿嚏精灵真的很爱捣蛋，一旦成功地让别人打了喷嚏，
它就会高兴地唱起这首《阿嚏歌》。

[P3] 阿嚏精灵有时躲在花蕊里，有时藏在柳絮里，有时
还趴在灰尘里。
没人知道它到底在哪里，也许只有你打了喷嚏后，
才会发现它偷偷来过。

[P4] 这天，阿嚏精灵早早就藏在了一朵美丽的月季花里了。
这么美的月季花，路过的人都忍不住停下脚步看一看。
“快来闻一闻月季花吧，嘿嘿嘿……”阿嚏精灵等不及
要大展拳脚了。

[P5] 阿嚏精灵等呀等，终于等来了一群前来踏青的小朋友。
瞧，那个叫美美的小女孩低下了头，轻轻地闻了闻月季花，阿嚏精灵就“嗖”地一下飞进了她的鼻子里。

[P6] “阿嚏，阿嚏，我是捣蛋阿嚏精灵，
最喜欢让人打喷嚏！阿嚏，阿嚏！”

在美美鼻孔的入口处，阿嚏精灵看到了左右两个通道，里
面生长着一根根黑黑的毛。
“虽然鼻毛可以阻挡灰尘、过滤空气，但对我来说可一点
儿用也没有。”

看！阿嚏精灵在鼻毛丛中玩了起来，它爬过一根又一根
鼻毛，还在上面荡起了秋千。

[P7] 果然，美美的鼻子立刻变得又酸又痒。
“阿嚏！阿嚏！”她一连打了好几个喷嚏，
“我的鼻子好痒啊——阿嚏！”

[P8] 鼻膜的黏液大军能杀死入侵的小细菌，但对阿嚏精灵一点儿效果也没有。
阿嚏精灵在美美的鼻子里得意地唱起了《阿嚏歌》。
阿嚏
幸好鼻子会打喷嚏，在美美用力地打了一个大喷嚏后，一股猛烈的气体把阿嚏精灵喷了出来。

[P9] 老师走过来告诉大家：“美美不停地打喷嚏，是因为花粉让美美的鼻子过敏了。打喷嚏是为了把进入鼻子的异物清除出去，不让脏东西进入身体里面。”
原来鼻子打喷嚏是在保护我们的身体呢！

[P10] “咦，这是什么？”大家看到小小的阿嚏精灵，十分好奇。
“大家好，我是会让大家打喷嚏的‘阿嚏’精灵！”阿嚏精灵说着，一下子就把身体变得和小朋友们一样大了。
小朋友们赶紧捂住了自己的鼻子和嘴巴，大家可都不喜欢爱捣蛋的小精灵啊！
Hi!

[P11] 美美和强强气呼呼地责备阿嚏精灵：“可恶的阿嚏精灵，打喷嚏让人太难受了！而且，你在我的鼻子里玩，我的鼻子被你弄坏了怎么办？
“对不起……我只是想和你开个玩笑，请原谅我吧！”阿嚏精灵不好意思地向美美道歉。“不如让它给我们讲一讲鼻子的知识，将功补过吧！”老师摸了摸阿嚏精灵的头，笑着对大家说。

[P12] 鼻子是用来吸入和呼出空气的。每个人都有两个鼻孔，鼻孔里布满了形状奇怪、凹凸不平的颗粒，除了过滤空气，还可以让人闻到各种气味。但如果鼻子堵塞了，就闻不到气味了。
健康的鼻腔
吸进的空气
鼻黏膜
纤毛
鼻腔内细胞
正常的鼻黏膜
溶菌酶
阻塞的鼻腔
吸进的空气
黏液分泌（由于粘液过多，纤毛被粘住了）
鼻黏膜充血（鼻腔感染）
大脑中枢
嗅神经
上鼻甲
筛窦区
前鼻孔气流

[P13] 当然了，即使阿嚏精灵没有在鼻子里捣蛋，也会有许多原因导致鼻子过敏和打喷嚏：
当季节和环境变化时，花粉、灰尘、温差过大都可能会引起鼻子过敏。
当生病感染时，病毒和细菌也会让鼻子不舒服。比如感冒了，也常常会出现流鼻涕、打喷嚏的情况。

[P14] 不过，每个人的鼻子大小和形状都不同，身体体质也不同。有些人不容易过敏，有些人却很容易过敏。过敏性体质的人需要特别注意保护自己的鼻子。
“你们知道有哪些预防鼻子过敏的好办法吗？”老师提出了一个问题。

[P15] 美美第一个回答：“我们可以戴上口罩，不让阿嚏精灵钻进鼻子里。”
“容易过敏的人在户外活动或季节变化时，特别需要戴口罩。”强强补充说。
“要多锻炼身体，让身体变得棒棒的，少生病。”琪琪说道。
妙妙说：“要注意鼻子的卫生，不要抠鼻孔，也不要往鼻子里塞东西。”

[P16] 容易引起过敏的食物
MILK
牛奶
花生
海鲜
芒果
鸡蛋
小麦
菠萝
“不要吃容易引起过敏的食物。”
“不要去灰尘多的地方。”
……
大家的回答都正确。老师让大家把所有的答案画了下来，还给每个人奖励了一张小星星贴纸。

[P17] 阿嚏精灵唱着《阿嚏歌》飞走了：“阿嚏，阿嚏，我是‘阿嚏’精灵，最喜欢让人打喷嚏！阿嚏，阿嚏！”
它是不是又去找别人捣蛋了呢？下一次它会藏在哪里呢？
full_text_en:
[P1] Baby Healthy Growth Picture Book Series, Volume 2
The Mischievous 'Achoo' Sprite
Zhang Dongmei / Text, Mei Yu / Illustrations
Jiangxi Higher Education Press

[P2] "Achoo, achoo, I'm the 'Achoo' sprite, and I love making people sneeze!
Achoo, achoo!"
The Achoo sprite really loves to play tricks. Once it successfully makes someone sneeze,
it happily sings this 'Achoo Song'.

[P3] The sneeze sprite sometimes hides in flower buds, sometimes hides in willow catkins, and sometimes
lies in dust.
No one knows exactly where it is. Maybe only after you sneeze
will you discover it has come secretly.

[P4] That day, the Sneezing Sprite had already hidden inside a beautiful rose.
Such a beautiful rose that everyone passing by couldn't help but stop to take a look.
"Come and smell the rose, hehehe..." the Sneezing Sprite couldn't wait
any longer to show off his skills.

[P5] The sneeze sprite waited and waited, and finally a group of children came to enjoy the spring outing.
Look, the little girl named Mei Mei bent down and gently smelled the rose, and the sneeze sprite zoomed in “whoosh” into her nose.

[P6] "Achoo, achoo, I'm the mischievous sneeze sprite,
I love making people sneeze! Achoo, achoo!"

At the entrance of Meimei's nostril, the sneeze sprite saw two passages on the left and right, with black hairs growing inside.
"Although nasal hairs can block dust and filter air, they're completely useless to me."

Look! The sneeze sprite started playing among the nasal hairs, crawling over one after another,
and even swinging on them like a swing.

[P7] Sure enough, Mei Mei's nose immediately became itchy and sore.
"Achoo! Achoo!" She sneezed several times in a row,
"My nose itches so much—achoo!"

[P8] The mucus army in the nasal membrane can kill invading bacteria, but it has no effect whatsoever on the sneeze sprite.
The sneeze sprite proudly sang the 'Sneeze Song' inside Meimei's nose.
Achoo!
Luckily, noses can sneeze. After Meimei sneezed hard, a powerful blast of air expelled the sneeze sprite.

[P9] The teacher walked over and told everyone, "Meimei keeps sneezing because pollen has made her nose allergic. Sneezing helps remove foreign objects from the nose and prevents dirty things from entering our bodies." 
It turns out that sneezing is a way for our noses to protect our bodies!

[P10] "What's this?" Everyone saw the tiny sneeze sprite and felt very curious.
"Hello everyone, I'm the 'Sneeze' sprite who makes you sneeze!" said the sneeze sprite, instantly growing to the same size as the children.
The children quickly covered their noses and mouths. Everyone disliked mischievous little sprites!
Hi!

[P11] Meimei and Qiangqiang angrily scolded the sneeze sprite: "You nasty sneeze sprite, sneezing is so uncomfortable! And you were playing inside my nose—what if you broke my nose?"
"I'm sorry... I just wanted to play a joke on you. Please forgive me!" the sneeze sprite apologized shyly to Meimei. "Why don't we let it tell us about the nose and make up for it?" the teacher said, gently patting the sneeze sprite's head and smiling at everyone.

[P12] The nose is used to inhale and exhale air. Everyone has two nostrils, which are filled with oddly shaped, uneven particles. Besides filtering the air, they also allow people to smell various scents. But if the nose is blocked, you can't smell anything.
Healthy Nasal Cavity
Inhaled air
Nasal mucosa
Cilia
Nasal cavity cells
Normal nasal mucosa
Lysozyme
Blocked Nasal Cavity
Inhaled air
Mucus secretion (due to excessive mucus, cilia are stuck)
Nasal mucosa congestion (nasal infection)
Brain center
Olfactory nerve
Superior turbinate
Ethmoid sinus area
Anterior nasal airflow

[P13] Of course, even if the sneeze sprite isn't causing trouble in the nose, there are many other reasons that can cause nasal allergies and sneezing:
When seasons and environments change, pollen, dust, and large temperature differences can all trigger nasal allergies.
When sick or infected, viruses and bacteria can also make the nose feel uncomfortable. For example, when you have a cold, you often experience runny nose and sneezing.

[P14] However, everyone's nose varies in size and shape, and so does their physical constitution. Some people are less prone to allergies, while others are very sensitive. People with allergic constitutions need to pay special attention to protecting their noses.
"Do you know any good ways to prevent nasal allergies?" the teacher asked a question.

[P15] Meimei answered first: "We can wear masks to keep the sneeze sprite from getting into our noses."
"People who are easily allergic especially need to wear masks during outdoor activities or seasonal changes," Qiangqiang added.
"We should exercise more to keep our bodies strong and get sick less," Qiqi said.
Miaomiao said: "Pay attention to nasal hygiene, don't pick your nose, and don't put things into your nose."

[P16] Foods that can cause allergies
MILK
Milk
Peanuts
Seafood
Mango
Eggs
Wheat
Pineapple
"Don't eat foods that can cause allergies."
"Don't go to dusty places."
...
Everyone's answers were correct. The teacher asked everyone to draw down all the answers and gave each person a little star sticker as a reward.

[P17] The Sneezing Sprite flew away, singing the 'Sneeze Song': 'Achoo, achoo, I'm the 'Sneeze' Sprite, and I love making people sneeze! Achoo, achoo!'
Is it going to cause trouble for someone else again? Where will it hide next?
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《捣蛋的“阿嚏”精灵》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师及出版社信息，并配有一个手持蒲公英的卡通精灵形象。
[P2] 本页描绘了‘阿嚏’精灵成功让一个男孩打喷嚏后，高兴地唱起《阿嚏歌》的场景，文字介绍了精灵爱捣蛋的特性。
[P3] 本页描绘了阿嚏精灵藏身于花蕊、柳絮和灰尘中的场景，并说明它行踪隐秘，只有在人打喷嚏后才会被发现。
[P4] 阿嚏精灵藏在一朵美丽的月季花里，准备对路过的人施展捣蛋本领，画面中精灵在花蕊中露出狡黠的笑容。
[P5] 阿嚏精灵在花丛中等待，当名叫美美的小女孩闻花时，精灵趁机飞进她的鼻子里，准备让她打喷嚏。
[P6] 阿嚏精灵进入小女孩美美的鼻孔，在鼻毛丛中玩耍，并自言自语表示鼻毛对它毫无用处。
[P7] 美美在花丛中被阿嚏精灵影响，鼻子突然又酸又痒，接连打了好几个喷嚏，周围的孩子和大人看到后都感到惊讶。
[P8] 美美因阿嚏精灵在鼻子里捣乱而打喷嚏，鼻腔内的黏液无法影响精灵，但最终一个大喷嚏将精灵喷了出来。
[P9] 老师向大家解释美美打喷嚏的原因是花粉过敏，并说明打喷嚏是身体自我保护的机制，画面中阿嚏精灵被喷出后晕倒在地。
[P10] 阿嚏精灵被美美打喷嚏后喷出，它向周围的孩子们自我介绍并变大，孩子们因害怕它而捂住口鼻。
[P11] 美美和强强责备阿嚏精灵，认为它让人打喷嚏很不舒服；阿嚏精灵道歉，老师提议让它讲解鼻子知识以将功补过。
[P12] 本页通过图解和文字说明了鼻子的结构和功能，包括健康与阻塞鼻腔的区别，并标注了大脑中枢、嗅神经、上鼻甲、筛窦区等部位，阿嚏精灵在一旁用教鞭指向图示，向孩子们讲解鼻子知识。
[P13] 本页解释了除了阿嚏精灵捣乱外，导致鼻子过敏和打喷嚏的其他常见原因，如花粉、灰尘、温差变化以及病毒细菌感染，并配以工厂、花粉、病毒等插图说明。
[P14] 老师在户外野餐时向孩子们提问，询问预防鼻子过敏的好办法，强调了不同体质对过敏的敏感度差异。
[P15] 孩子们在老师的引导下，纷纷提出预防鼻子过敏和保持鼻腔健康的方法，包括戴口罩、锻炼身体和注意鼻部卫生。
[P16] 本页展示了容易引起过敏的食物，如牛奶、花生、海鲜、芒果、鸡蛋、小麦和菠萝，并呈现了老师对孩子们正确回答的肯定，奖励每人一张小星星贴纸。
[P17] 阿嚏精灵唱着歌飞走，孩子们在草地上野餐，猜测它下次会去哪里捣蛋。
